observations: Photo 0: A black, tall rectangular console with a perforated top panel, green lights visible through the holes. A black Xbox controller is placed on top. The console sits on a glass table with a landline phone and other small items nearby. The background includes a beige wall and an orange patterned curtain.

Photo 1: A front-facing view of the same console, showing the perforated top, a horizontal slot near the top front, and a vented lower front panel. A black controller is on top. Cables are connected at the bottom. The console is on a glass surface with a red patterned rug in the background.

Photo 2: A side view of the console, showing its slim profile, a small circular button or port near the top, and a vertical slot. Cables are visible at the bottom, including a power plug. The console is on a glass table with a beige wall behind it.
The console has the distinctive shape and design of an Xbox Series X, including the tall, black, rectangular form, perforated top, and front slot for disc insertion.

The controller on top has the standard Xbox layout: two analog sticks, D-pad, four colored face buttons (red, green, blue, yellow), and central Xbox button — consistent with an Xbox Series X controller.
No visible branding or model text is readable in any photo. The seller's text claims it is an Xbox Series X, but no photo confirms this with a visible label or logo.
The console appears to be in good physical condition with no visible cracks or damage. The green lights in photo 0 suggest it may be powered on or in standby mode.
